summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. furnished its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026 via Form 6-K, a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change—is described. The filing solely contains standard quarterly financial results and an operating and financial review, incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. This is a routine earnings update with no event-driven catalyst or structural change for investors to monitor.
